instruction: Starting facing the toilet with a weird green carpet cover, turn to face the right towards the rest of the bathroom. THen as we pass the tub and the vanity make a left and walk out of the bathroom and into the master bedroom, with a choice of a couch and a quite large bed. Walk forward and stand in front of the bed with the dresser next to you. Finally, let's walk around the bed and exit through the door, through the exit into the hallway with tiles. On the very first right you can take into another hallway, take that right. Then walk down the hallway beside the living room with the green couch. Take small left into a little pit stop passing a small wet bar, a bathroom, and come to a stop in front of the media room before taking an about face and going back the direction we came. Finally, we are going to walk into the living room next to the very large mantle and television with the couch and coffee table to our left. Continue straight forward and towards the open door to the outside, coming to a final stop in front of the door looking out into the balcony and the backyard with its outside dinning table and pool.
